units.name: Bloodblade
units.description: Heals 2 whenever it hits a unit.

units.name: Warlock
units.description: Costs 1 mana. Hits at exactly range 2 and heals 2. Bat Form (free, before moving): fly like a Bat this turn and turn back on landing.

units.name: Nightstalker
units.description: Fragile, but one hit drops most archers, casters and scouts.

units.name: Bat
units.description: Three vampire bats take the field together. Fast fliers that feed with every bite.

units.name: Blood Thrall
units.description: A chained, bloodied servant. Slow and tough, and it feeds on its victims.

units.name: Blood Countess
units.description: A noble sorceress. Crimson bolts from range 2-3 cost 1 mana and drain life.

units.name: Blood Hunter
units.description: A vampire knight on a black steed. Charges, bites and drains blood in one turn.

units.name: Vampire Lord
units.description: Elite (5 slots). An ancient lord on bat wings. Blood Nova cleaves the target and the 2 hexes beside it, and drains the life from his prey.

units.name: Blood Queen
units.description: Boss (5 slots). Exsanguinate: Defeating a unit heals her to full.

units.name: Nosferatu
units.description: Boss (5 slots). Mist Step: Flies 4 hexes. After it attacks it turns to mist and takes 2 less damage until its next turn.

units.name: Crimson Matriarch
units.description: Boss (5 slots). Blood Pact: Each hit steals 1 mana from the target's player.

units.name: Bat King
units.description: Boss (5 slots). Swarm Call: The first time it is hit each round a Bat appears next to it (up to 3).

units.name: Night Watcher
units.description: Scout. Sees far through the fog of war. Flare (1 mana): light up 2 hexes around a hex up to 5 away until your next turn; enemies there take +1 damage from your attacks and enemy snares there burn.

units.name: Hemomancer
units.description: Binds an enemy with a Crimson Tether that drains it for 3 turns (2 mana).

units.name: Mesmerist
units.description: Charms an enemy hero into striking one of its own allies (3 mana).

units.name: Duskweaver
units.description: Weaves a Veil of Night that hides your units from enemy eyes and arrows (2 mana).
